name: OmShakthy Mathura Elite
amenitiesIntro: Thirumazhisai — Chennai's Rapidly Developing Western Corridor. Well-connected to the Chennai-Bengaluru Highway, this prime location places you near major workplaces, renowned schools, hospitals, and upcoming developments, ensuring a lifestyle of convenience and strong investment potential.
connectivityIntro: Thirumazhisai is no longer a suburban location, it is becoming Chennai's next major growth hub — anchored by the Chennai-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor (CBIC), a proposed metro rail extension, and direct connectivity to the Outer Ring Road.
tagline: A Premium Residential Community Crafted for Modern Living, where Comfort & Connectivity Come Together.

narrativeSections.heading: Launching in Thirumazhisai
paragraphs: OmShakthy Mathura Elite is a new CMDA & RERA-approved residential plotted development spread across 2 acres in Thirumazhisai, offering 70 plots ranging from 635 sq.ft. to 1,097 sq.ft. — a gated community designed around comfort and everyday convenience.

The project sits along the Chennai-Bengaluru Highway corridor, one of the city's fastest-growing western belts, with the Chennai-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor (CBIC), a proposed metro rail extension, and the Outer Ring Road all shaping the area's momentum.

narrativeSections.heading: A Connected Western Corridor
paragraphs: Located off the Chennai-Tirupati State Highway, Thirumazhisai offers excellent connectivity to Poonamallee, the Kuthambakkam Bus Terminus, the Outer Ring Road, the Sriperumbudur Industrial Corridor, Pattabiram, Thiruvallur, and Koyambedu & Anna Nagar.

Nearby infrastructure landmarks include the Peripheral Inner Ring Road, Tidel Park, and SIDCO Thirumazhisai — placing the project within reach of major employment and IT hubs while keeping a quieter, residential setting.

narrativeSections.heading: Planned for Everyday Living
paragraphs: Every plot is designed around a grand entrance arch, black-top internal roads, solar LED street lighting, avenue tree plantation, a dedicated EB facility, round-the-clock security, and a compound wall — infrastructure built for a comfortable, secure community from day one.
Whether it's education, healthcare, shopping, or entertainment, everything is just minutes away, making life at Mathura Elite both effortless and enriching.

narrativeSections.heading: Invest with a Trusted Developer
paragraphs: OmShakthy Homes brings over three decades of experience as one of Chennai's leading land facilitators and developers, with 5,000+ acres facilitated and zero litigation — trusted by clients including Pepsico, BSNL, Mahindra World City, SIPCOT, and Reliance.
With OmShakthy Mathura Elite, buyers get CMDA & RERA-approved plots in a corridor still early in its growth curve. Book a free site visit to see the layout and evaluate the surroundings for yourself.
